 Faisal Malik Draws Inspiration from Mark Ruffalo’s Hulk for Kumbhakarna Role in Ramayana
 Actor Faisal Malik, cast as Kumbhakarna in Nitesh Tiwari’s upcoming Ramayana, reveals he used Mark Ruffalo’s portrayal of the Hulk as a reference point to capture the character’s massive scale and physical presence. Zoom TV Digital Updated Oct 20, 2026, 04:07 PM IST
 Faisal Malik In Ramayana: Part 1
 Actor Faisal Malik has shared insights into his preparation for the role of Kumbhakarna in director Nitesh Tiwari ’s upcoming film, Ramayana. Known for his work in the series Panchayat and the film Gangs of Wasseypur, Malik revealed that he looked toward the Marvel Cinematic Universe for inspiration when conceptualizing the physical presence of the legendary asura. Specifically, he cited Mark Ruffalo’s portrayal of the Hulk as a primary reference point for embodying the character's immense stature and power. In a recent discussion with Variety India, Malik acknowledged the significant challenge of portraying a figure described in mythology as being of colossal height. He noted that the process of transforming into such a behemoth required a shift in perspective, as the character is far removed from the human roles he has played in the past. For Malik, the opportunity to participate in the project is a significant career milestone, describing the experience as a dream come true given his familiarity with the source material from childhood. Bringing a Mythological Behemoth to the Screen
The portrayal of Kumbhakarna involves navigating the complexities of a character defined by his legendary deep sleep and his status as the brother of Ravana. Malik emphasized that the technical and creative demands of the role are unique, particularly in capturing the essence of a character who is not a conventional human. By drawing parallels to the Hulk, Malik aims to convey the sheer scale and physical dominance associated with the asura, whose mythological descriptions suggest a height of several hundred feet. The production of Ramayana is a collaborative effort involving Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios, DNEG, and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations. The film features a prominent ensemble cast, with Ranbir Kapoor starring as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. The supporting cast includes Ravie Dubey as Lakshman and Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman. The project is structured as a two-part cinematic event, with the first installment slated for a worldwide release on November 5, 2026, followed by the second part in Diwali 2027. Distribution for the film will be handled by Sony Pictures internationally, while Dharma Productions will manage the release within the Hindi-speaking markets of India. The production is also confirmed for a worldwide IMAX release, with plans to debut in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam. As the project moves toward its scheduled release dates, Malik’s performance remains one of the anticipated elements of this large-scale mythological adaptation. End of Article Zoom Now
